finding: P7-LOW-6 UnlockProtocolGovernor — capital / recoverability / activity follow-up
title: Unlock governance: 3M UP quorum costs $3,511.78, a failed attempt loses only $20.54, but 6.58M-47.11M UP of observed opposition and a 39.45M whale make capture E-U ~$0
headline_note: The mechanism is real and cheap: 3,000,000 UP costs 1.655510 WETH = $3,511.78 through the live UniV3 pool (spot $3,352.18), the stake only needs to be held for ONE block (~2s) around the snapshot, propose takes no deposit, and a failed attempt loses only $20.54 (99.4% of capital recovered). But $3k buys quorum, not victory: the observed opposition is 6.58M-13.69M UP and the max is 47.11M UP; two prior 'govscan capture' proposals both failed (0/2); the real defender is 0xf5c28ce2 with 39,447,548 votes, not the deployer. Conditional upside if the DAO is completely asleep: $26,914 net (nominal prize $47,405; UP leg only realises $9,540).

failure_case.propose_deposit: none — only the 50,000 UP threshold via getVotes(proposer, clock()-1); no escrow
failure_case.cancel: proposer only while Pending (4-day delay); no cancel after voting starts (no CANCELLER_ROLE anywhere)

timing.hold_required: 1 block (~2 seconds) around the snapshot, not 4 days
timing.same_block_flashloan_reason: buy+sell at the same block.timestamp overwrites the checkpoint to 0/50k

success_model.risk_adjusted_ev: approximately $0; the 3M ticket is positive-EV but almost never wins; the 13.69M stake only works if the whale abstains and MEV is avoided

closed_reasons: the vote is the binding constraint: observed opposition 6.58M-13.69M UP, max 47.11M; 0/2 direct capture attempts succeeded
the 39.45M whale 0xf5c28ce2 votes Against on every contentious proposal; the 390.56M Safe is undelegated but available; 13.69M stewards defeated the 2026-10-29 attempt
the DEX cannot supply >14.53M UP, and 13.69M costs $180,375 with $165k mark-to-market/MEV exposure > the $26.9k realisable prize
the 4-day delay + 6-day vote give the DAO 10 days to react; a 13.69M buy is a visible price spike
key_facts: CORRECTION: deployer 0x81Dd955D02D337DB81BA6c9C5F6213E647672052 holds 59,735.099462 UP (59,735,099,462,003,103,689,691 wei), NOT 59,735,099.46 UP; its on-chain VoteCast weight is 59,735.099462. ca3 H1's 59.7M is a 1000x decimal error.

50,000 UP (threshold) costs 0.026341850542624522 WETH = $55.88; round-trip loss $0.33. propose() has no deposit/escrow; the 50k must be held one prior block (getVotes(proposer, clock()-1)) and can be sold immediately after.

Snapshot timing: UP uses clock()=block.timestamp. Buy 3M at snapshot-2, sell at snapshot+2, getPastVotes(snapshot)=3,050,000 and castVote weight 3,050,000. The required hold is 1 block (~2s), NOT the 4 days pass7 assumed.
Same-block flash loan fails: buy+sell at the same block.timestamp overwrites the checkpoint to 50,000; getPastVotes(snapshot)=50,000, vote weight 50,000.
With the deployer voting Against (59,735), a 3.05M For proposal still SUCCEEDS (fork test 09). The deployer cannot stop the attack.
With the 39,447,548-vote whale 0xF5C28ce24Acf47849988f147d5C75787c0103534 voting Against, the 3.05M For proposal is DEFEATED (fork test 08); the attacker's loss is $20.54 and the 3M is recovered.
Unopposed 3.05M For passes and executes: timelock drained of 26,858,278.41 UP + 6.4312 ETH + 2,697.40 USDC + 0.4971 WETH; UP leg dumped for 4.4974 WETH ($9,540); net $26,914.
Activity: 158 proposals (2024-08-05 to 2026-10-29), 99 executed, 54 no-quorum, 3 defeated, 1 canceled, 1 succeeded-not-executed; turnout min/median/max 0 / 5,109,177 / 47,569,740 UP; 34/158 below 3M.
The deployer voted 2/158 times (1.3%), both Against. Delegate 0x38b826a4 cast 103 votes (79 For / 24 Against); 0x9ded35ae 103 (100/3); 0xca763232 111 (83/28); whale 0xf5c28ce2 6/6 Against.
Two 'govscan capture' attempts: 2026-10-13 (0 For vs 6.58M Against, no quorum) and 2026-10-29 (3.40M For vs 13.69M Against, DEFEATED). 0/2 successes. Max observed Against 47.11M on 2026-09-19.

Acquisition routes: UniV3 0x9EF81F4E is the only scalable public route (14.53M UP / 6.62 WETH); Aerodrome has <0.9M UP; no CEX; UP is Base-native with no bridge; the UPSwap 0x12be7322 holds 54.08M UP at a fixed 1 UDT = 1000 UP but UDT's only market is a $270 UniV2 pool (OTC-gated).
UP is freely transferable: stock OZ ERC20+ERC20Votes+Ownable, no pause/blacklist/lock/vesting/transfer tax; owner() is the timelock; no l1Address (not bridged); no CEX tickers.

UP is not listed on Aave V3 Base (getConfiguration=0) or Compound III (BadAsset); Morpho Blue is permissionless but no liquid UP market was found. Borrowing WETH for the 1-block hold is possible but requires collateral and does not change the exposure.
caveats: Governance behaviour is social, not code: the p estimates are calibrated judgment; the 13.69M coalition can escalate with the 39.45M whale, and the whale's abstention on 2026-10-29 is not a guarantee for the next proposal.

The 3M failure loss is $20.54 only if no other trader interleaves; a full capture of the 4.8% price impact by an MEV bot raises it to ~$160 (still small). The 13.69M loss is similarly execution-dependent, up to ~$165k if the impact is captured.

The 13.69M acquisition's $165k mark-to-market impact is only recoverable if no other trader sells UP into the temporarily 12x-priced pool between the buy and sell; a 2-block MEV window can capture it. The $586.92 round-trip loss assumes no interleaving trades.
The UPSwap/UDT route is OTC-gated; UDT's on-chain market is ~$270 deep, so 3,000 UDT cannot be bought publicly. Its depth is unknown.
The token/price/timelock state is point-in-time 2026-11-10 (block 55,433,658); re-read before acting. The timelock's UP/USDC balances fell after executed payments (pass7 had 27.17M UP / 3,997 USDC).
The 1-block hold assumes Base produces a block at or after the snapshot timestamp; a skipped block only widens the hold by one block (~2s), not four days.
The 50k threshold is spammable: 51 proposals appeared in Sept 2026, mostly zero-vote spam; this does not drain funds but can fatigue voters.
one_liner: Unlock's 0.3% quorum is $3,511.78 of capital and only $20.54 of at-risk cost (1-block hold, no deposit, 99.4% recoverable), but $3k buys quorum not victory: 6.58M-13.69M UP of observed opposition, a 39.45M whale, 0/2 prior capture successes and a 47.11M max Against make E-U ~$0; the deployer's '59.7M' is a 1000x decimal error (actual 59,735 UP), and the conditional upside if the DAO sleeps is $26,914.
